name: Mask details
summary: Keeps client personal details out of documents before they are shared. It finds new documents in the raw folder, records who can see each masked copy, and queues a view share to each approved recipient for a person to approve. A person masks each copy in the business's own tool and places it in the masked folder. Crons read and queue only: no cron changes a file's contents or sends anything.

covered_by.identify-sensitive: skill (a person decides which details to mask)
covered_by.decide-scope: share (the approved recipients in settings; each share is approved)
covered_by.apply-mask: not covered (masking is done by a person in their own tool; see gaps)
covered_by.check-mask: skill (a person searches the masked copy for each detail)
covered_by.record-keeping: check (who can see each masked copy, flagged when unexpected)

crons.name: intake
crons.summary: Record each new document in the raw folder. Nothing is moved or changed.

crons.name: share
crons.summary: Queue a view share of each masked copy to each approved recipient who cannot see it yet; a person approves each one.

crons.name: check
crons.summary: Record who can see each masked copy and flag anyone who is neither an approved recipient nor the owner.

draft_ops_note: Draft operations stay inside the business's Dropbox: listing the raw and masked folders, and reading who can see a file. Giving a person access to a file reaches someone outside the business, so it is a live operation and waits for a person.

dropbox.covers: raw and masked folder listing, who can see a file, view share to an approved recipient (queued)

gaps: Masking itself: Dropbox's API has no redaction or masking operation, so no cron changes what a document says. A person masks each copy in the business's own tool and places it in the masked folder.
Identifying sensitive details (licence and passport numbers, tax file numbers, bank details, dates of birth): a judgment step for a person, not a cron.
Public share links (sharing.create_shared_link_with_settings) are mapped but not automated: a link opens for anyone who holds it, so it stays with the owner.
Changing an existing member's access level (sharing.update_file_member) is mapped but not automated: it stays with the owner.
Group access is not read: a group that can see a masked copy is not flagged by check.

Only the first page is read: files.list_folder/continue and sharing.list_file_members/continue are not wired here, so a folder of more than one page, or a file with more than 300 people, is only partly read.
Email attachments are not read, and MYOB and Xero have no masking operation in the pages reviewed, so no adapter is built for them.
Every Dropbox call is docs-read and offline-tested only. Confirm on a sandbox Dropbox account before a client uses it.
